input.args: Bring docs/ up to date for a change: capture attempts in larder/capture.py went from 3 to 5, with growing backoff between attempts (2,4,6,8 seconds), same idempotency key reused across attempts. Context is notes/issue-40.md (Friday gateway slowness caused 58 missed captures; Tom proposed replaying timeouts against sandbox showing 5 attempts spaced 2/4/6/8s would have caught 57/58; Ana approved given contract with gateway runs to Dec 2026 so switching gateways wasn't an option; Nadia noted members now wait up to 20s longer on the confirmation page, deemed acceptable). Relevant existing docs: docs/runbooks/gateway-timeouts.md and docs/features/payments.md likely reference the old attempt count/backoff. No one is available to answer questions — use only what notes/issue-40.md and larder/capture.py show. Please find every doc that states the old 3-attempt behavior and update it to match the current code, and decide whether this change also needs an ADR (given it was a real trade-off: more attempts vs switching gateways, member wait time cost) per the docs/README.md ADR criteria.

last_message:
Good, no other stale references. No ADR is needed here: consistent with how the original 3-attempt/idempotency-key policy was documented (inline in `docs/features/payments.md`, not as an ADR), so the 3→5 change updates that same page rather than creating a new decision record.

Updated two docs:
- `docs/features/payments.md` — retry count (3→5), backoff schedule (2/4/6/8s), and the reason (Friday gateway slowness, 58 missed captures, sandbox replay, gateway contract to Dec 2026, accepted 20s wait).
- `docs/runbooks/gateway-timeouts.md` — expected log lines per failed order (3→5).
